verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Triggers and SLO burn alerts can route to custom webhooks that accept JSON payloads, with docs detailing payload customization via variables and Go template functions to shape actionable content for downstream automation, which supports triggering remediation scripts or agents. This is well-documented first-party capability though there's no independent case study of an AI agent specifically receiving and acting on these webhooks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent consuming these webhooks end-to-end, and any built-in agent-specific webhook templates beyond generic JSON.
